NO DATA IS AVAILABLE. AN ALTERNATE OFFEROR IS REQUIRED TO PROVIDE A COM PL ETE DATA PACKAGE INCLUDING DATA FOR THE APPROVED AND ALTERNATE PART FOR EVALUATION. 

DLA Land and Maritime is considering a future solicitation(s), and subsequent award, of an Indefinite Quantity Contract (IQC/LTC) for the item(s) on the market research spreadsheet. The resultant IQC/LTC could potentially range from 3 to 5 years in length. Please provide any adddtional sources that may be able to manufacture these items. 

Interested persons may identify to the contracting officer their interest and capability to satisfy the Government's requirement with a commercial item in response to this notice; refer to the market questionnaire.
